title: Admin advances the fulfillment state machine

card.i_want: to move a paid order through packing, shipped and delivered
card.so_that: customers can track fulfillment and the history stays correct

context: Transitions are forward-only (paid->packing->shipped[tracking required]->delivered); illegal backward moves are rejected and every transition is audited with the actor.

acceptance_criteria.when: the admin moves it to packing then shipped with a tracking number then delivered
then: the shipped transition is rejected if the tracking number is blank

acceptance_criteria.when: the admin tries to move it back to packing or to cancel a delivered order

acceptance_criteria.scenario_name: re-submitting the same transition is idempotent
given: an order already moved to shipped
acceptance_criteria.when: the same shipped transition is submitted again

then: an audit event {event, actor, ts, order_id, before, after, audit_id} is emitted

pii_fields.justification: the admin operates on order ids and statuses; customer PII view is limited and inventoried in ORDER-01

audit_events.justification: each transition must record the acting admin and before/after

idempotency.justification: a re-submitted transition must not double-apply

reversibility.justification: illegal backward transitions are rejected; admin cancel-before-packing releases stock
reversibility.compensating_action: reject illegal transitions; release stock on admin cancel before packing

authn_authz.justification: only admin role may transition orders

regulatory.justification: internal fulfillment operation, no regulated processing
